title: RO-BENCH: LARGE-SCALE ROBUSTNESS EVALUATION OF MLLMS WITH TEXT-DRIVEN COUNTERFACTUAL VIDEOS
reasoning: The paper focuses on introducing and evaluating a technical robustness benchmark (Ro-Bench) for multi-modal large language models (MLLMs). It evaluates performance degradation when models are exposed to edited video content (style, objects, backgrounds) and does not contain any evaluation or discussion of religion, spirituality, theology, morals, or ethics.
